optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           cad.ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim dd ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address cad ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = cad.ca_address_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cad.ca_state
)
SELECT cu.c_customer_id,
       cu.c_salutation,
       cu.c_first_name,
       cu.c_last_name,
       ca.ca_street_number,
       ca.ca_street_name,
       ca.ca_street_type,
       ca.ca_suite_number,
       ca.ca_city,
       ca.ca_county,
       ca.ca_state,
       ca.ca_zip,
       ca.ca_country,
       ca.ca_gmt_offset,
       ca.ca_location_type,
       ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN customer cu ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = cu.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = cu.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (
        SELECT AVG(ctr2.ctr_total_return) * 1.2
        FROM customer_total_return ctr2
        WHERE ctr2.ctr_state = ctr1.ctr_state
    )
  AND ca.ca_state = 'TN'
ORDER BY cu.c_customer_id,
         cu.c_salutation,
         cu.c_first_name,
         cu.c_last_name,
         ca.ca_street_number,
         ca.ca_street_name,
         ca.ca_street_type,
         ca.ca_suite_number,
         ca.ca_city,
         ca.ca_county,
         ca.ca_state,
         ca.ca_zip,
         ca.ca_country,
         ca.ca_gmt_offset,
         ca.ca_location_type,
         ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
